gettysburginteractivemap.com is provided free of charge, with no account, no subscription, and no payment of any kind. There is no paid tier.

Acceptable use

You're welcome to use this site for personal, educational, or classroom purposes, including linking to it, embedding its widget on your own page, and citing it in student work. Please don't scrape the underlying data files for republication as your own dataset, and don't attempt to disrupt the service (automated hammering of the map or data endpoints, attempts to bypass access controls, and similar abuse).

Historical accuracy

Unit positions, casualty figures, and troop strengths are compiled from published historical sources (including the Official Records and Busey & Martin's regimental strength tabulations) and researched in good faith, but this is not a peer-reviewed academic work. Where the underlying source data disagrees with itself, this site notes the discrepancy rather than silently picking one number. Historical positions, especially at five-minute resolution, are a best-effort reconstruction and should not be treated as forensically exact.

The underlying historical facts (troop movements, casualty counts, unit designations) are not owned by anyone and are free to reference; please credit gettysburginteractivemap.com if you republish substantial excerpts of the written vignettes or the compiled data.

This site is provided "as is," without warranty of any kind. We work to keep it accurate and available, but we don't guarantee uninterrupted access or that every historical detail is beyond dispute.
